name: omaslack
author: Scabb Island
description: Slack for Omarchy, from the bar and from the terminal, on one local daemon: an unread dot, a quick-view panel with quick replies, and a full window.

barWidget.description: A Slack unread dot and quick access to the omaslack window and terminal client.

schema.label: What lights the dot
schema.description: Which unread conversations light the dot on the icon: every one, or only DMs and mentions aimed at you. The tooltip and the panel always list every count.

schema.label: Open conversations in
schema.description: Where right-clicking the icon or picking a conversation in the panel opens it.

schema.label: Hide when nothing is unread
schema.description: The icon takes no space in the bar while nothing is unread.
